target: Fresh nonauthor hostile semantic/interface/source review of the eventual complete accelerated ordinary rooted binary MAF solver. No complete candidate has been released to this reviewer.
main_goal: Explicit full ordinary exact algorithm, universal correctness/termination and rigorous O*(c^k),c<2.3391. The review initially prepares functional verification; runtime/base stay OPEN unless separately supplied and verified.

conventions.q: cut budget=k-1 for k>=1; never silently accept k=0 by Nat subtraction
conventions.input: Two rooted binary trees with identical unique leaf labels. Ordinary labels are arbitrary Nat values.
conventions.agreement_forest: Nonempty label blocks partition all original labels; the induced rooted labeled restriction on each block agrees between trees up to sibling order and unary suppression; original minimal subtree vertex sets for different blocks are disjoint in both trees. Minimal hull of a singleton is its leaf. No current-source clearance shortcut.
conventions.result: Globally minimum number of components if within budget, otherwise a correct bounded negative. Malformed refusal is separate from valid-input infeasibility. Actual API empty/singleton conventions must be checked after release, not guessed.

also_licensed: Root AGENTS.md and bootloops/tools/README.md, relevant tool guides, applicable .agents/skills, installed Lean/Python runtime sources/docs, own new files only.
forbidden_before_exact_root_release: Agent inventories, author/peer messages, linked summaries
Browsing author build directories or following candidate artifact links
may_assume: The pinned ordinary mathematical specification, subject to logged ambiguities
Installed compiler and standard library as explicitly declared trust, not scientific proof by process exit
must_not_assume: Candidate algorithm correctness, coverage, termination, a smaller base or novelty
Ordinary oracle supplied as an executable algorithm step
Properness-specific equality on arbitrary malformed callback inputs
Linear candidate count means linear runtime
Forest-call mass equals expanded ordinary recursion mass
A combined work constant containing ordinaryWork may be multiplied unchanged at every paid level
precontact_deliverables: Immediately write a workfile skeleton after reading this target.

Design fresh graph and set-partition/restriction checks with no shared validity callback and no project code reuse. Derive hand truth fixtures before execution, with source/bit/count conventions explicit.

Freeze hand fixtures, hostile boundary cases, and deliberately corrupted or incomplete acceptance cases before candidate contact. Execute planted positive and negative controls, including an incomplete cover that retains an optimum but loses a required witness.

Prepare fresh independent Lean stored-producer/source pin/body/axiom controls: private/unused/opaque hidden axioms, duplicate nonproof values in both import orders, missing/duplicate rows, wrong source/binary paths and hashes, proof body actual dependency traversal. Complete nonproof data and opaque bodies must be retained.
Measure pilots before expansion; no exhaustive beyond n=6 before reporting timing and actual coverage. Small tests are finite evidence, never a universal proof.
Write READY with all own files/pins, contact/failure ledger, scope/debt and a source replay/consumer trace plan; then STOP candidate contact and report readiness to root. No self-release.
later_release_plan: Root will supply an exact immutable whole-solver package only after READY. Reconstruct from spec, trace every consumed hypothesis and actual call site; independent exact oracle comparisons and cold Lean source closure plus actual producer/axiom/body checks. No VERIFIED-CLOSED before protocol fresh semantic/interface/referee gates.
erratum_rule: Flag ambiguous or inconsistent conventions; preserve original expectations and failures. Log any postcontact adaptation, no blind credit for repair. Do not alter the target or expected values silently.

resources.notes: No raw dependency producer dumps or global historical census; use bounded compressed module shards. All process stops/failures remain. No children.

ownership: Only verification/fast-ordinary-solver-2026-10-15/sol-independent/ and results/algorithm-universal233-fast-solver-independent-*; never modify author artifacts, frozen records, shared progress JSON or runtime dependencies.
independence: Fresh context; authored no candidate work. No author/peer contact or agent inventory. Record every accidental exposure and source/runtime trust; root pin/hash checks create no replication credit.
